description:
Introduction
This ticket implements a specific WCAG 2.2 issue identified in the WCAG 2.2 analysis.

Affected CMS Section / Feature App: Search Layer
Success Criterion: 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)

Current Behavior (As-Is)
Input focus is unclear: the search input has a 2px bottom border instead of the standard focus treatment.

Accessibility Impact
Users may not be able to clearly perceive that the input has keyboard focus.

Target Behavior (To-Be)
The Search Layer input has a more visible focus state, consistent with the focus styling used elsewhere. The focus indicator must remain unobscured.

Dependencies
UI/UX input required: Yes.
Content changes required: No.

Acceptance Criteria
- WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) is met.
- The Search Layer is fully usable without a mouse.
- Focus and interactive elements are visually and programmatically perceivable.
- The solution works across relevant viewports.
- The approved UI/UX focus treatment is applied consistently.

Testing Scope
Validate both Classic Search and AI Search variants. Verify opening, focusing, searching, navigating results, and closing the Search Layer with keyboard only.
